preconditions.expression: all(4 <= int(n) <= 5000 and n <= int(m) <= 3*n for n, m in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (4 ≤ n ≤ 5000) and m (n ≤ m ≤ 3n), representing the number of vertices and edges in the graph.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n for v, u in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:m+1]]))
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains two integers v and u (1 ≤ v, u ≤ n), representing edges between vertices. The graph is connected, has no loops, and each vertex has degree ≤ 3.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 and 1 <= int(line) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+1:])
preconditions.description: After initial placement, each subsequent line is either Nastya's starting vertex (first line) or her new vertex after each move (1 ≤ vertex ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == 3 and all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each output line must contain exactly three integers (1 ≤ a, b, c ≤ n), representing the positions of the three bees.

postconditions.expression: any(all(int(bee) == int(nastya) for bee in stdout.splitlines()[i].split()) or all(int(bee) != int(nastya) for bee in stdout.splitlines()[i].split()) and int(nastya) in [int(bee) for bee in stdout.splitlines()[i].split()] for i, nastya in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[m+1:], 1))
postconditions.description: The game ends when at least one bee and Nastya are on the same vertex at any turn (either after bees move or after Nastya moves).
The game terminates within n moves (n is the number of vertices), where n+1 accounts for the initial placement.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == 0 or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 1 and len(stdin.splitlines()) == m + 1) or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == i + 1 and len(stdin.splitlines()) == m + i + 1 for i in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The interaction alternates strictly: initial placement (1 output line) followed by pairs of bee moves (output) and Nastya moves (input), until termination.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n and (v != u) for v, u in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:m+1]])
invariants.description: The graph remains static with vertices labeled from 1 to n and edges connecting distinct vertices.

invariants.expression: all(degree(v) <= 3 for v in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: The degree of every vertex in the graph is at most 3 throughout the game.
